newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-STOICHKOV TO MISS BULGARIA'S WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STOICHKOV TO MISS BULGARIA'S WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Barcelona striker Hristo Stoichkov has pulled out of Bulgaria's World Cup qualifier away to Cyprus next week because of injury, the Bulgarian state news agency BTA said on Thursday.
BTA quoted head coach Hristo Bonev as saying Stoichkov had told him by telephone he had torn a muscle fibre and could not play against Cyprus on December 14.

His place will be taken by Lyuboslav Penev who was dropped for using insulting words on local television after the Euro 96 championship in England. He is a nephew of ex-national coach Dimitar Penev who was axed in July after Bulgaria's poor showing at Euro 96.
Volatile Stoichkov missed Bulgaria's first two qualifiers after vowing to quit the team unless the country's soccer chiefs resigned.
Bulgaria lost their opening World Cup qualifying match in Israel but beat Luxembourg in their second.
